quickRevision.title: Primitive vs Object
quickRevision.summary: JavaScript values are primitive or object based.

quickRevision.title: Primitive Characteristics
quickRevision.summary: Primitives are immutable and copied by value.

quickRevision.title: Object References
quickRevision.summary: Objects are stored and copied by reference.

quickRevision.title: Memory Model
quickRevision.summary: Stack stores references, heap stores objects.

quickRevision.title: Copying Objects
quickRevision.summary: Shallow and deep copies behave differently.

quickRevision.title: Assignment
quickRevision.summary: Assignment operators store and update values.

quickRevision.title: Comparison
quickRevision.summary: Comparison operators return true or false.
